### Show prices

Filters stations by how recently their price was last reported:

*   **All** — every station, any price age
*   **Last 3 days** — prices reported in the last 3 days
*   **Last 24 hrs** — prices reported today

Can't see a station you expected? Some retailers — supermarkets especially — update less often, so they can fall outside the shorter windows. Tap **All** to show everything.

Each card also shows a 🟢 fresh / 🟡 aging / 🔴 stale dot with the date, so you always know how current a price is.

### 💷 Save Per Tank

This shows how much you could save on a full tank by filling up at the **cheapest** station instead of the **average-priced** station in your search area.

**How it's calculated:**  
(Average price − Cheapest price) × Your tank size

Based on your selected vehicle's tank size (Car: 55L, Motorbike: 15L, Van: 80L). Switch vehicle in the Filter panel to update.

### 📊 Map Savings Tracker

Each time you search on the map, we calculate the potential saving between the cheapest and average station. This running total shows your **cumulative potential savings** from map searches this year.

🔒 **100% private:** This data is saved in your browser's local storage on your device only. We cannot see it, we don't collect it, and it never leaves your phone or computer.

This tracker is separate from the one on the main list page — each page tracks its own searches independently.

This is an estimate based on your searches, not a guarantee of actual savings.

Enable location permissions to find your current location or enter an address. If you're outside the UK, location detection won't work, but you can still use the search feature.

## Map FAQs

Can I choose Google Maps or Apple Maps for directions?
Yes. Open the **Filters** popup and scroll down to the **MAPS** section, where you can pick which app the **Directions** and **Navigate** buttons open:

*   **Auto** — uses Apple Maps on iPhone, iPad and Mac, and Google Maps everywhere else
*   **Google** — always opens Google Maps, even on an iPhone
*   **Apple** — always opens Apple Maps

So if you're on an iPhone but prefer Google Maps, just set this to **Google** and your choice is remembered on your device.

How do I find the cheapest petrol station near me?
Allow location access or enter your **postcode, town or city** in the search box. The map will show every station within your search radius, and you can sort by **cheapest**, **nearest** or **most recently updated**. Tap any station marker to see its live prices, address and amenities.

Is the map free to use?
Yes — PetrolPrices.co.uk is **completely free** to use, with no sign-up or account required. All features, including the map, sorting, filtering, station details and live prices, are available at no charge.

How accurate are the fuel prices on the map?
Fuel prices come from the **UK government's mandatory fuel price transparency scheme**, which requires retailers to publish forecourt prices within 30 minutes of any change. We sync this feed every **15 minutes**, so prices shown are at most around 15 minutes old.

What do the green, amber and red badges mean?
These are our **price freshness badges**, which show how recently each station last reported its prices:

*   🟢 **Green** — updated in the last few hours
*   🟡 **Amber** — updated within the last day or so
*   🔴 **Red** — older than that, treat with caution

We surface this so you can judge whether a "cheap" price is genuinely current or potentially out of date.

Can I save my favourite stations?
Yes — tap the **heart icon** on any station card or popup to save it. Your favourites are stored on your device and shown on the [Favourites page](https://www.petrolprices.co.uk/favourites.php), where you can also see **price change badges** and opt in to **push notifications** when your saved stations change price.

How do I sort or filter stations on the map?
Use the **sort buttons** at the top of the results to switch between **Distance**, **Cheapest** and **Recently Updated**. You can also choose your **fuel type** (Unleaded, Diesel, Super Unleaded, Premium Diesel) and adjust the **search radius** to widen or narrow your results.

Why don't I see prices for some stations?
We only show prices that come directly from the UK government's official fuel price feed. If a station appears **without a price**, it means that retailer hasn't reported one — usually because they're a smaller independent who isn't yet part of the scheme, or because their feed has temporarily dropped out. Major brands (BP, Shell, Esso, Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda, Morrisons, etc.) are all reliably covered.

[See all FAQs](https://www.petrolprices.co.uk/faq.php)

### How to Use the Fuel Map

#### 1. Enter a Location

Type a postcode, town, or city into the search box. Then click "Get Prices" for a list or "Find Nearest" to see results on a map.

#### 2. Tap 📍 to Find Stations Near You

Tap the  location button to instantly find the cheapest fuel stations near you. Your browser will ask for permission to use your location.

#### 3. Filter Your Results

Use the filter pills (Distance, Price, fuel type) to sort and refine the stations shown. Tap "Brands" or "More" for additional filtering options.

#### 4. View Station Details

Tap any price marker on the map to see station details, or tap "View List" to see all results in a scrollable list.

Dots are dearer stations hidden behind cheaper ones — zoom in or tap to see. To show every station as a full price card, switch on "Show all prices on map" in Settings.

#### 5. Save Your Favourite Stations

Tap the  star icon on any station to save it as a favourite. Visit your [Favourites](https://www.petrolprices.co.uk/favourites.php) page to track prices and get notified when they change.
